implementation: A fixed-conditioning-point stationary likelihood field with exact nine-amplitude square root, declared nonlinear box and analytic real-arithmetic residual/outgoing-state envelope. This zero-order field is a baseline for error accounting, not a selected accurate battery compressor.
domains: Public-mean-centered box with halfwidth0.01 times public eta widths, conditional only
Singleton public mean, exact conditional control
centroid_scope: Exact coordinate translation and joint uncertainty algebra; independent-observation linear regression using four-knot natural-cubic basis as a small sufficient-statistic control. Not battery centroid fitting or a selected aging model.
spline_controls: Natural-cubic basis partition and linear reproduction
Unique-observation regression batch/stream equality and exact recentering
Monotone same-knot path counterexample within30percent change
Piecewise-linear error bound M*h^2/8 under an explicit second-derivative bound

numeric_allowances.meaning: Finite regression checks, not a proved rounding enclosure or physical accuracy requirement

scope_limits: No new physical health transitions or forgetting
No resetting accumulated error on merge or recenter
No assumption that overlapping rolling posteriors are independent
No actual-cell coverage or ten-year certificate
